effect: Initialize all 138 UPS curVal values and expand existing enabled 10-second pilot job to all 138. Offline values frozen at baseline; two unsupported points receive synthetic values. No deletions or history backfill.

request.expression:
do
  diff(readById(@p:mytest:r:323a8968-4ac6fd41), {dis:"UPS 全部138点模拟当前值", jobExpr:"do\n  ts: now()\n  fraction: ts.time.second.as(1) / 30 - 1\n  readAll(point and upsDemo).each(p => do\n    value: p->upsBase\n    if (p->kind == \"Number\" and p->upsScenario != \"offline\") value = p->upsBase + p->upsAmplitude * fraction\n    diff(p, {curVal:value, curStatus:\"ok\", upsSourceTs:ts, upsLastGoodAt:ts}, {transient}).commit\n  end)\n  {updatedAt:ts, points:readAll(point and upsDemo and curVal).size}\nend"}, {}).commit
  do
    ts: now()
    fraction: ts.time.second.as(1) / 30 - 1
    readAll(point and upsDemo).each(p => do
      value: p->upsBase
      if (p->kind == "Number" and p->upsScenario != "offline") value = p->upsBase + p->upsAmplitude * fraction
      diff(p, {curVal:value, curStatus:"ok", upsSourceTs:ts, upsLastGoodAt:ts}, {transient}).commit
    end)
    {updatedAt:ts, points:readAll(point and upsDemo and curVal).size}
  end
end
